audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 read Skill/Yone/Yone here, but the mirror (already audited) set all three to Garen and its layers now match its packet row for row.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is an 8s auto-reset that silences, and Judgment is down to 6s at rank 5 — before your first item he wins every short exchange he starts, and whys[1] already said Garen-favoured while win[1] said Skill.
audit.corrected: Garen through Levels 4-5; you take over at first item and hold it, which is what the 50.44% win rate over 5418 games reflects.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried no numbers and the level 6 row was justified with a wrong description of your own ultimate.
audit.why: Courage is 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5; Judgment 9s to 6s; Decisive Strike a flat 8s; Demacian Justice 120/100/80s. Your Soul Unbound runs 22s to 10s and Spirit Cleave 14s and shrinking with attack speed.
audit.corrected: His spikes are Courage rank-ups and level 6; yours are the first crit item and Soul Unbound's cooldown collapsing to 10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed described as setting up 'team knockups nothing can dodge'; the Decisive Strike silence was listed as a generic 'favourite window' with no mechanical content; Demacian Justice's true damage never stated.
audit.why: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone it clipped toward Yone — no airborne. Decisive Strike silences, which locks out Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed outright, and it is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell rather than the cast. Courage grants tenacity, which does nothing against Mortal Steel's airborne. Demacian Justice is true damage on an execute threshold, so resistances are the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Open with the Q3 airborne — his tenacity does not shorten it. Refuse trades into a fresh Decisive Strike: the silence takes Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed away entirely. Stay above the Demacian Justice threshold; armour and MR do not blunt it.

edits.after: Garen-favoured: his Q silence and 6-second spin out-trade you here.

edits.after: Garen-favoured: a landed Q-E chunks you before you trade back.

edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last enemy and pulls; it never knocks up. Demacian Justice is true damage — stay above the threshold.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Garen carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls the enemies it clips toward you instead of knocking them up. Garen carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Damage reduction. Trade when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Courage shields, adds tenacity, then damage reduction — 22s at rank 1, 12s at 5.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction. Trade when it’s down. When it is down — Q3-R him.
edits.after: Courage is 22s at rank 1 and grants tenacity, so lead with the Q3 airborne, which tenacity cannot cut.

edits.before: That is Garen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences — it locks out Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed entirely.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Courage blunts your burst for its duration — wait the 22s out.

notes: Chart rows Level 2, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 flipped to Garen in matched pairs to agree with the already-audited mirror, and the three whys[] rows that said 'Skill' were rewritten so the text agrees with the chart.
